description: This Java source file defines the class MongoClientWrapper, a thread-safe wrapper for MongoDB client interactions tailored for the Ditto project. It provides methods for initializing the client with various configurations, accessing databases and collections, and managing MongoDB change streams and sessions.

classes.name: MongoClientWrapper
classes.description: A thread-unsafe wrapper around the MongoDB reactive client, providing database access and management functions.

classes.name: MongoClientWrapperBuilder
classes.description: A builder class for constructing instances of MongoClientWrapper with customizable settings for connection string, SSL, pool size, timeouts, and other configurations.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new MongoClientWrapper using provided MongoDbConfig settings.

methods.name: getBuilder
methods.description: Returns a builder for creating a MongoClientWrapper, either blank or preconfigured with MongoDbConfig.

methods.name: getDefaultDatabase
methods.description: Returns the default MongoDatabase instance for this client.

methods.name: getCollection
methods.description: Retrieves a MongoCollection with the specified name from the default database.

methods.name: getDatabase
methods.description: Retrieves a MongoDatabase for the specified database name.

methods.name: listDatabaseNames
methods.description: Returns a reactive stream publisher of database names.

methods.name: listDatabases
methods.description: Returns a reactive stream publisher of databases.

methods.name: watch
methods.description: Creates a change stream publisher for monitoring changes in the MongoDB server.

methods.name: startSession
methods.description: Starts a new MongoDB client session.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the MongoClient and any associated event loop groups.
